name: Anaho Bed
description: Our Anaho Bed is the perfect combination of classic Japanese structural design and modern influence. The headboard is formed from two slats of live wood. The two headboard slats are supported by three unique hourglass shaped pieces to add flair while aiding in the sound structure. The flat sideboard is long enough to rest your feet on, and four black metal legs keeps the bed suspended in air. If you’re looking to sleep peacefully while adding modern refinement to your space, then the Anaho Bed is for you.
